original_test_intent: Validate Extended Starting Address for each applicable Type 19 mapped range only when the legacy Starting Address sentinel makes the 64-bit byte-address field authoritative, with correct range ownership and reboot persistence.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 16/19/20 and OS-map data, verify version/length and the legacy start sentinel, pair the 64-bit extended start with Extended Ending Address and array handle, validate ordering/topology, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user defines expected 64-bit ranges and reboot plan; no physical or memory-map change is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Legacy Starting Address sentinel and extended-field applicability
Expected Extended Starting/Ending ranges per Type 16 array
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/OS-map queries; never alter firmware, kernel, DIMMs or mapping.
Use Extended Starting Address only when the legacy start equals the defined sentinel and the structure contains the field.
Preserve raw 64-bit byte addresses and pair with the same record's extended end; do not truncate.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on invalid ordering/ownership or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Gate field authority by sentinel/length, parse full 64-bit ranges, resolve Type 16 ownership and Type 20/OS context, and compare pre/post reboot.
Report inapplicable, absent, truncated, reversed, overlapping or drifting ranges without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve extended-address applicability, expected ranges/reservations and reboot plan.
Resolve legitimate OS-map differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove legacy-sentinel activation, structure presence, paired 64-bit end or array ownership.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 16/19/20 and OS map; report legacy sentinel, structure length, raw 64-bit start/end, normalized range, owner and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Extended Starting Address scope, Type 19 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no mapping change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Gate the extended start by the legacy sentinel and structure length, pair it with the extended end, validate 64-bit ordering/ownership and correlate the complete map before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 19 implementations containing extended address fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and OS-map versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 19 legacy-sentinel and Extended Starting/Ending Address definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authority gating, raw 64-bit pairing, ownership and map topology.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects ignored/inapplicable extended fields, truncation and wrong-owner or overlapping ranges missed by grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved 64-bit range map and sentinel/applicability policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An extended value is not authoritative when its legacy sentinel condition is unmet; OS reservations require separate interpretation.

project_override_considerations: Projects may use legacy ranges when addresses fit or extended ranges when required, but must apply the sentinel rule and document expected full ranges; they cannot treat any displayed extended value as authoritative by default.
expected_evidence: Approved extended-address/sentinel/structure policy and expected map
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/19/20 records with versions/lengths
Per-range legacy sentinel, raw extended endpoints, array ownership and topology result
Read-only OS/e820 comparison with reservations identified
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot semantic diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Extended Starting Address is valid but conditional; expected ranges and applicability are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Conditional parsing, 64-bit range validation and persistence comparison are automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds sentinel authority, length, paired endpoint and ownership/topology checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains conditional-field safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps missing platform policy as readiness rather than a capability reduction.

review_improvement: Prevents a displayed 64-bit start from passing when the legacy field did not activate it, it is truncated, or it belongs to an invalid range.
independent_technical_reasoning: Extended-start authority and 64-bit range checks are deterministic schema operations; approval and expected values do not make the core manual.
